description: A real mouse drag lifts the pair, shows a live insertion and drops a free preview without spending an attempt
Only explicit confirmation spends an attempt; accepted placement has inserted-letter arrival and a contained success flourish
Outside release and Escape cancel a real drag without placements, attempts or leftover highlights
Wrong gaps receive the same neutral drag preview and only become an error after confirmation; no success burst leaks correctness
Reduced motion preserves drag/preview/confirmation without ghost travel
Cancelling a different-pair drag or Escape restores the existing paid nudge preview without another charge, including reload
Real mouse edge scrolling reaches lower words in this browser and a cancelled release remains free
Chromium native emulated touch drag drops a free preview, confirms with touch, and edge-scrolls the long phone board without charging a cancelled drag
Incoming terminal progress cancels an in-flight drag and prevents a stale drop from creating a preview
